alexcrichton commented on PR #14908:

For something that's roughly intended to be a debugging-ish server this feels like wasmtime serve is starting to sprawl quite a lot -- for example custom I/O implementations, hardcoded HTTP prefixes and such, this all feels pretty intense for what is otherwise intended to be a relatively simple wrapper around hyper and wasmtime together. Is it possible to simplify this and/or externalize the complexity? For example I see that hyper-util has utilities for handling either 1.1 or 2 connections, that might be appropriate?

Also, is this valid? I thought that http/2 required TLS and AFAIK we don't have any configuration to have wasmtime serve serve over TLS.

xia-chao commented on PR #14908:

i'm pretty sure h2c is valid ,rfc 9113 has prior knowledge for cleartext, http/2 doesn't need tls. ran curl --http2-prior-knowledge and got a 200.
